title: SpaceX successfully executes first chopstick catch of Starship
excerpt: SpaceX successfully captured the Starship vehicle for the first time using its Mechazilla launch and catch tower.
body_html: SpaceX has successfully captured the Starship vehicle for the first time using its Mechazilla launch and catch tower. The maneuver, often referred to as a chopstick catch, was performed on the Starship vehicle itself following an earlier aborted attempt to catch the booster during Flight 15. While the company has previously executed similar chopstick catches with its boosters, this marks the first time the complex procedure has been successfully completed using the Starship spacecraft.
